_note: GTA VI vehicle finder data, Nov 22, 2026 (Nov 24: speed, class and real-life fields re-sourced to GTABase's vehicle database after GTABase rewrote its fastest list on Nov 22). Read Nov 22 ~05:15-05:35 UTC via WebSearch/WebFetch (no Chrome, no billed tools). Rockstar has published no vehicle list, prices or stats, so each field comes from named guide sites with its date, compared where more than one reports it. Status per field: 'official' = Rockstar or a console store; 'agree' = two or more different publishers say the same, and every cited source carries its own 'claims' note (our short record of what that source states, read Nov 22), so the agreement can be checked per source; 'disagree' = sources give different answers (all shown; can be two pages of one publisher); 'single' = one guide only. A field set to null means no source we read reports it: the page says so instead of guessing. 'classes' are the filter groups the class text names (empty when no class is reported). 'speed' is the in-game Speed stat out of 10 as GTABase and GamerBlurb print it, not a measured top speed. 'price' is GTABase's in-game scan: sell value of a stolen car, cost to register it as yours, and its tracker. 'cars' links a row to a car on the real-cars list below (data/cars.json, journalists' matches) as '<section id>/<game name>'. Our own wording throughout; no guide prose or per-location lists copied; no images. Pre-launch lists that mix in leaks (Beebom's vehicles list, TechWiser, RankedBoost) and AI-written guides are not used. Never add leaked, datamined or rumored vehicles.

rules.text: No dealerships: you get cars by stealing them, then registering them at a Pay 'n' Spray to keep them.
Scanning a car with the WAiNK phone app shows its stats, condition and security before you try to take it.
An in-game phone app shows what a car would resell for and what it costs to register it as yours.
Cars with a standard or advanced tracker can't be modified until you register them. Registering and selling open up as the story goes on.
A stolen car you haven't registered is gone for good if you lose or wreck it; registered personal vehicles can always be recovered.
Hunting for an exotic? GTABase's tip: watch Vice City traffic and the hotel strip on Ocean Drive, where it keeps seeing Pfister, Grotti, Enus and Ocelot models.

coverage.text: Coverage on Nov 24: 40 vehicles named by guide sites, almost all in the first days after launch, with class, how to get it, price, speed stat and real-life inspiration wherever a guide states them. Blank means no guide we read reports it yet. Not yet: per-car spawn locations (one so far, where two guides agree), measured top speeds, and the full roster (GTABase's database now lists 590 vehicles of every kind; this finder covers the 40 cars at least one guide described in detail).

speed.text: The speed figure is the in-game Speed stat out of 10, as GTABase, IGN's Official Guide and GamerBlurb print it. Nobody has published measured top speeds yet. GTABase's ranked fastest list (rewritten Nov 22) now covers the whole roster and puts late-game supercars far above the cars here: Andrew Node's Truffade Thrax at 9.2 and three Progen Emerus variants at 8.9 (GTABase only so far).

price.text: Prices are in-game scans published by GTABase and IGN's Official Guide: what a stolen car sells for and what it costs to register as yours. There are no showroom prices because there are no dealerships, per GTABase.

independence.text: IGN's and GamerBlurb's figures match GTABase's exactly wherever they overlap. That most likely means each read the same in-game stat screen, but one could also have copied another, so "Guides agree" means two named publishers state it, not that Rockstar confirmed it.

supercars.text: Supercars from the trailers, such as the Furia, Zorrusso and Tempesta, appear in Dexerto's post-launch list, but no guide has published their stats, prices or where to find them yet. Dexerto also gives some of them different makers (Piccia Furia, Granforma Zorrusso) from the names car outlets used in 2023. Their real-life matches are in the trailer sections below.
